scope: Selected extracted provisions and retained proposal/advice records, not exhaustive session or mission compliance coverage.
limitations: Selected provisions are not automatically mandatory requirements applicable to every peace operation.
Documentary adoption and repository publication do not establish implementation, owner approval or financial benefit.

public_evidence_needed: Final text/corrigenda completeness refresh and adopted follow-up instruments through release cutoff
Public Secretary-General implementation reports with paragraph-level attribution
controlled_evidence_if_authorized: Action-specific accountable owner and authorized implementation decision
Dated implementation records and material component coverage
Performance population, exceptions and service guardrail records
Full-system cost records only where a financial effect is claimed
requests.proposed_custodian_role: Responsible substantive office and records custodian; exact custodian not yet confirmed
requests.handling: Do not send automatically or place restricted records in Git; use approved intake after custodian authorization.
requests.minimum_scope_rule: Request only the applicable action/entity/period; resolve applicability before collecting transaction-level records.
